text:
sam: heads-up: after the kernel-selector tweak that prefers micro-kernels, ingress hosts show a p95 spike in tokenize+parse (~26% increase) during the canary window.

dee: ack. any quick flame or counters so we know if it's tokenization, framing, or syscalls?

sam: flame snippet from a 60s sample:
```
CPU 60s total
  ingress/tokenizer.go:scanTokens   16s  (27%)
  ingress/parser.go:parseFrames     9s   (15%)
  grpc/writer.go:flushSmallWrites   6s   (10%)
  kvcache/client.go:batchLookup    3s   (5%)
  selector/score.go:rankKernels     1s   (2%)
```

yuki: looks like tokenize+parse dominated but flushSmallWrites is nontrivial. any change in socket write distributions?

sam: yes. pre-canary small_write(<300B)=18% -> canary 62%. selector variant counts: micro=5%->48%. kv hit-rate dipped ~3.4%.

marco: likely cause: selector preferring micro kernels reduced average inference chunk size, causing the ingress to emit many small frames + more parse overhead. Also if variant tags are appended to kvcache keys we might be increasing key variance.

dee: immediate mitigation: revert the micro-kernel bias in canary, and add a soft coalesce in grpc writer (don't flush until buffered >=512B or timeout). Also temporarily increase minibatch_timeout_ms to 6ms.

monitor-bot: deploy-canary dee/revert-micro-bias -> ingress-canary-5 started at 1781234680 :rocket:

sam: rolling the revert now. collecting parse_cpu, small_write_rate, kv_hit_ratio.

yuki: add ephemeral metrics: parse_bytes_per_request, grpc_coalesce_misses/s, selector.variant_counts. small samples (30s) will be fine.

marco: note for selector: consider adding an "expected_host_frames" penalty into the score so that kernels that reduce model compute but increase host IO get balanced. filing INF-5201.

monitor-bot: canary update at 1781234800: 10m post-revert samples: parse_cpu -19%, small_writes -54%, kv_hit returned to baseline. p99 latency stable.

dee: great signal. next steps:
- land GRPC soft-coalesce guard (config default 512)
- add unit test that simulates forced micro-variant selection with fragmented input to reproduce the flush pattern
- prototype selector cost term for host-framing penalty and run 1h A/B with streaming-heavy corpus

marco: I'll anonymize some sample kvcache keys to check key-length effects; early diff shows we append "-micro" (+6 bytes avg). Not huge but combined with higher request rate can increase memcmp cost.

sam: I'll open the revert PR + metrics export and the coalesce patch. dee will own the selector prototype.

monitor-bot: canary completed at 1781234920 \u2705 3/3 healthy.

dee: adding "simulate streaming-fragmentation" to kernel-change checklist so future selector changes run the scenario in the perf harness. these cross-layer interactions are easy to miss.

sam: thanks all, good triage — will follow up with PR links and perf dashboards.
